_comment: Line limits for tracked Markdown files. scripts/check_md_budgets.py reads this file. Skills are capped only when listed in `files`: the agent-run skills, which agents load every run. Other skills, such as experiments, have no cap (the null default). A file at its limit can change only when it stays at the same length or gets shorter: replace or delete a line for each line you add. See the docstring of that script.
